clue.text: Labour happy to secure Cameron's end — cause of personal stink

parts.note: labour as hard toil, the kind that makes you perspire

indicators.note: to secure something is to hold it fast, so one piece is held inside another

parts.note: a plain synonym

indicators.note: the end of a name is its final letter, so only that one is kept

parts.note: the final letter of the Prime Minister's surname

explanation.surface: A jibe that Labour would gladly see David Cameron finished, framed as the source of a political stink.
explanation.walkthrough: SWEAT, then GLAD holding the N: SWEAT GLAND. 'Personal stink' is body odour, not political scandal.
explanation.definitionFit: Sweat glands in the skin produce the perspiration that bacteria turn into body odour.

clue.text: (& 9dn.) Staff working on sod all: make over needed, as you'd expect from McDonald's

indicators.note: something working is in motion and being changed, so its letters are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written, to be rearranged
sod all is British slang for nothing, and nothing is the zero-shaped letter

indicators.note: turned over means flipped round, so the short word runs the other way

parts.note: to make or carry out, as in do a job

explanation.surface: A dig at a burger chain's workforce, doing nothing and in need of a makeover, as you'd expect from McDonald's.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sod all' is British slang for nothing at all. The rearranged STAFF gives FASTF, then O and the turned DO finish FAST FOOD.
explanation.definitionFit: McDonald's is the archetypal chain selling quickly prepared burgers and fries, the standard example of this kind of meal.

clue.text: Erection doubtful after second time

explanation.walkthrough: 'After' tells you IFFY comes after S and T.
explanation.definitionFit: Stiffy is British slang for a penile erection.

clue.text: Minor story revealing the actions of a familiar royal (e.g. went topless)?

explanation.definitionFit: The title is a well-known children's book and literally describes the doings of someone called Katy.

explanation.definitionFit: The voyeur's peephole in a bedroom door is the traditional way to spy on what goes on inside.

clue.text: Life worth living? — and idiot put up with Lloyd Webber work!
